subject: Recap: procurement route + hosting preference (next steps)
messages:

Subject: Recap: procurement route + hosting preference (next steps)
Attachments: Clydesys-MAP-v1.pdf, SOW-draft.docx

Hi Sofia — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a handful of questions so we can align Redwood's commercial path with Clydesys procurement: 

Summary (from call)
- Primary goal: roll out an LLM-powered search assistant across 3 internal apps; initial pilot ~Q4 '26.
- Perf target: 95th pct latency < 300ms for UI flows; expected steady-state ~2500 requests/day during pilot.
- Security: SOC2 + standard IP protections required; potential interest in Private later for data residency.

Open/confirm items for procurement team
1) Billing method: does procurement require a PO/Net terms (AP-managed) or can you use corporate card initially?
2) Marketplace: would you prefer to buy via AWS Marketplace (Consolidated billing / SaaS contracts) versus direct Redwood invoice?
3) Contract/Paperwork: who is the procurement contact and do you have a standard SOW/MSA template we should align to?
4) Timing: expected sign timeline (procure + legal) and budget owner.

Commercial path choices for alignment (high-level)
- Hosted (on-demand): fastest to start, pay-as-you-go (card or invoice), minimal setup. Good for pilots.
- Dedicated (reserved GPUs): predictable throughput, recommended for sustained production. Typically requires a commit (3/6/12mo) for discounted pricing.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): for strict compliance or data residency; procurement + infra lead times are longer.

What we need from you to prepare an accurate commercial proposal
- Procurement preference (PO/net terms vs card)
- Interest in Marketplace purchase (yes/no)
- If Dedicated is of interest, a rough commit horizon (3 / 6 / 12 months) or target throughput (tokens/day or qps)
- Procurement contact + legal reviewer email(s)

Next steps
- I attached a 1-page MAP we use to align milestones + SOW draft. If you can confirm the procurement path and introduce your AP/Legal contacts, Karthik and I will prepare two pricing options: pilot (hosted on-demand) and a dedicated commit proposal with tiered discounts.

Thanks — Neha

Thanks Neha — great summary. Quick answers below, copying Marta from procurement (she handles AP/Net terms):

- Billing method: We prefer PO + Net30 for anything > $5k/month. For an initial pilot under $5k/month we can use a corporate card.
- Marketplace: Interested in AWS Marketplace if we can get the same pricing and consolidated billing; it's preferred by finance for SaaS.
- Procurement contact: Marta Lopez (marta.lopez@clydesys.com) — she'll own contract/PO.
- Timeline: pilot approvals expected within 2–3 weeks; procurement/legal can turn around PO + standard SLA redlines in ~2–3 weeks after SOW.

Regarding hosting: our eng team likes the idea of starting hosted on-demand for the pilot to move quickly; if performance and cost justify it, we will look at a Dedicated commit for Q1 '27. Can you confirm what commit levels you typically recommend (throughput or tokens/month) and typical discount ranges? Also, what lead time to spin up Dedicated GPUs is required?

I attached our internal procurement checklist (not shared here).

— Sofia

Hi Sofia / Marta — thanks for the quick reply and for looping Marta in. Answering your questions and making the recommendation we discussed: 

1) Recommended immediate path: start with Hosted (on-demand) for the pilot to remove infra friction and shorten time-to-value. Use corporate card for sub-$5k months, then transition to PO/Net on ramp if the pilot meets goals.

2) Dedicated commit sizing guidance (ballpark):
- Small commit (3mo): equivalent to ~2 r5 GPUs, approx 250k tokens/day sustained; ~15–20% discount vs on-demand.
- Medium (6mo): ~4 GPUs, 500k tokens/day; ~25–30% discount.
- Large (12mo): full pool (6+ GPUs), 1M+ tokens/day; 30–40% discount + priority capacity.

These are starting points — we will size precisely based on actual qps and sequence lengths from your pilot. Lead time: Dedicated pools typically provision in 2–3 weeks after contract/commit is finalized.

3) Marketplace: happy to list on AWS Marketplace for Clydesys — pricing parity is something we can include in the contract. Buying via Marketplace is fine; it speeds up CFO/Finance approvals in many customers.

4) Procurement paperwork: I attached a draft SOW for the pilot (covers success criteria, SLAs for Hosted, and options for Dedicated rollouts). If Marta or your legal team has redlines, we can accept standard procurement changes but will flag any clause that materially affects service levels.

Action items (who / when):
- Marta: confirm PO cadence and send any SOW/MSA templates (requested) — by EOD Wed 10/07 if possible.
- Karthik: I asked him to prepare two commercial exhibits: (A) Hosted pilot pricing (monthly estimate & overage model) and (B) Dedicated commit ladder (3/6/12mo) with discount table — deliver by Wed 10/07.
- Neha/Aditya: will include a Marketplace addendum option and note on lead times.

If that timeline works, we’ll prepare a concise commercial packet you can share with finance.

Thanks — Neha
